result.summary: The 2023 page drops the 2022 mission statement ('accelerate the world's transition to sustainable energy') and founding story, adding 'Accelerating the World's Transition to Sustainable Energy' as a headline. New emphasis on 'Make it (Ridiculously) Fun', 'extreme scale', and 'first-principles' problem solving; safety and fossil-fuel-transition commitments are reframed; the 2022 safety-training commitment is removed.
